heroTitle: A garden to enjoy all year round
heroText: We design and care for outdoor spaces suited to the Mediterranean climate, your home and the time you want to spend maintaining them.
aboutTitle: Beauty, shade and balance in every corner
aboutText: A good garden is about more than attractive plants. We study orientation, soil, irrigation, how the space will be used and future maintenance to create a coherent outdoor area that is easy to enjoy.
servicesTitle: From the first sketch to everyday care
servicesIntro: Flexible solutions for homes, communities, accommodation and small businesses.
s1Text: Zoning, plant selection, paths, lighting and solutions adapted to the available space.
s2Text: Pruning, cleaning, growth control, lawn care and seasonal attention.
s3Text: Installation, inspection and adjustment of irrigation systems to make better use of every drop.
s4Text: Renewal of borders and the addition of trees, shrubs and Mediterranean plants.
processTitle: We listen, observe and help the idea grow
step1Title: We get to know the space
step1Text: We discuss your needs and inspect the garden's conditions.
step2Text: We define the layout, plants, materials and required work.
step3Text: We coordinate preparation, planting, irrigation and finishing.
step4Text: We explain the care required or schedule regular maintenance.
projectsTitle: Every garden tells a different story
projectsIntro: Inspiration for patios, residential gardens and Mediterranean green corners.
q1: Do you work with small gardens?
a1: Yes. A patio, terrace or compact garden can also make better use of its space with the right layout and plants.
q2: Can you choose plants that need little water?
a2: Yes. We prioritise species that suit the climate, orientation and desired level of maintenance.
a3: Yes. The frequency is adapted to the garden, the season and the work required.
q4: Do you install or repair irrigation systems?
a4: Yes. We can install, inspect and adjust irrigation to improve coverage and reduce water loss.
contactTitle: Your next garden begins with a conversation
contactText: Tell us where you are, what space you have and what you would like to achieve.
